name: model-vetting
description: Two paired skills for vetting an AI model artifact before you adopt it: model-scorecard (zero-friction triage over the public HuggingFace API — no token, no download — returning a coarse (format, loader) risk tier and a plain-language card) and model-eval (the deep static read for models that ship custom code — deterministic collector, a behavioral claim written twice and checked against the code's actual call graph, generation-to-sink traces, plain-English report). Executes nothing from the artifact and never issues a clearance.
